body: Change of plan on Saturdays: we're keeping the 2 pm closing after all. The 6:30 pm change announced yesterday is cancelled.
New hire: Anita Rao joins as accounts assistant on Monday 1 December. She'll sit with Caio for the first week.
Meridian Foods accepted Q-118b (₹19,200 plus GST). PO number MF-4471 received by email.
Kaveri Textiles asked for a quote: 1,200 printed mailer boxes, two colours. Need the artwork before I can price it.
Someone mentioned Kaveri usually pays late, so maybe ask for 50% advance.
INV-2211 for Harbor Retail is ₹48,500. Updated the Invoice tracker.
Raised INV-2215 to Meridian Foods for ₹19,200 plus GST against PO MF-4471, due 26 December.
Meridian Foods delivery moves from 27 November to Monday 1 December, same morning slot. Patel Transport confirmed.
Correction to my earlier message: the Meridian delivery is Tuesday 2 December, not Monday 1 December. Patel can't do Monday.
We all agreed last week to stop using WhatsApp for client orders, everything goes through email from now on.
